description: A restart of the host process it's keeping till nothing blocks it: what asked for it, whether a head's holding it, and what it waits for. Every head shows the same.

by.description: What asked for it: a head (Restart Daemon), or its own updater (a newer version).

to.description: The commit it'll restart onto, when its updater asked.

paused.description: A head is showing what it waits for: it won't restart till that head's let go.

blockers.description: What it waits for, oldest session first.
